clue.text: Respect some hesitation in one's excuses, perhaps

indicators.note: the hesitation sound is set inside the word for one's excuses

parts.note: a defence is the case one offers to excuse oneself
er is the sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: Someone's polite hesitation is read as a feeble attempt at excusing themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing respect means yielding courteously to another's wishes or standing.

clue.text: Number of the Spanish flat

parts.note: el is the Spanish word for the
even means level or flat, as a smooth surface

explanation.surface: An address: a numbered apartment in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a cardinal figure, one more than ten.

clue.text: Turns out not to one's choice

definitions.text: Turns out not to one's choice

parts.words: Turns out not to one's choice
parts.note: a landlord turning out tenants removes them against their own wishes, not by their choice

explanation.definitionFit: Expelling occupants from a property is done against their will.

clue.text: Get money out of misdemeanour

parts.note: ex means out of or former
a tort is a civil wrong in law

explanation.surface: Someone is fined for a minor offence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get money out of' reads as one phrase, but 'out' gives EX and 'of' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To obtain cash by threats or force is the verb's sense.

clue.text: Mean to examine some money

parts.note: to con is to study or scrutinise, as in conning a text
a note is a piece of paper money

explanation.surface: A stingy person intends to look over some cash.
explanation.definitionFit: To imply or signify something beyond the literal sense.

clue.text: The richer for not getting on?

definitions.meaning: a gambler who does not get on a horse, that is place a bet, is a punter staying out

explanation.surface: Someone is wealthier because they stopped gambling.
explanation.definitionFit: Being more prosperous is one sense; a punter who is out of the betting is the other, read as a gambler absent.

clue.text: Reliable watch to look after

parts.note: safe means secure and dependable
to watch over is to guard

explanation.surface: A trustworthy sentry is posted to keep an eye on things.
explanation.definitionFit: To protect something from harm is to care for it.

clue.text: I'm in a race for life

indicators.note: the letters of I'm go inside the phrase for a race

parts.note: a nation is a people or race

explanation.surface: A runner declares they are entering a race of their life.
explanation.definitionFit: Animation means liveliness, vitality or the state of being alive.

clue.text: Recover concerning profit?

parts.note: re means about or concerning
gain is a profit

explanation.surface: A question about getting money back on an investment.
explanation.definitionFit: To get back something lost is to retrieve it.

clue.text: Oppose an insect repellent

parts.note: to resist is to oppose
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: Advice on fighting off a bug with insect repellent.
explanation.definitionFit: Something repellent keeps things out, being impervious or proof against them.

clue.text: Master-switch for the current

indicators.note: to switch the letters around rearranges them

explanation.surface: Instructions about the main switch controlling the electric supply.
explanation.definitionFit: A brook or river is a flowing current of water.

clue.text: A leading Roman?

parts.note: an officer of the Roman army who led a company of a hundred soldiers

explanation.definitionFit: Such an officer commanded a century of legionaries.

clue.text: He may produce stupor-in his readers?

definitions.text: He may produce stupor-in his readers?

indicators.note: the letters of the word stupor are worked into a new arrangement, a name

explanation.surface: A dull author sends readers into a daze.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed hyphen in 'stupor-in' is an OCR join; the anagram uses STUPOR alone.
explanation.definitionFit: The French novelist of the vast In Search of Lost Time is famously long-winded.

clue.text: Moderate team peter out

indicators.note: out means the letters of team and peter are disordered

explanation.surface: A side's effort fizzles to a mild level.
explanation.definitionFit: Restrained or mild in behaviour or climate.

clue.text: Retired permanently on grounds of ill health

definitions.text: Retired permanently on grounds of ill health

parts.words: Retired permanently on grounds of ill health
parts.note: retired here means gone to bed, and staying there for good through sickness

explanation.definitionFit: Someone confined to bed by illness has gone there and stays.

clue.text: A classic dream once in circulation

indicators.note: circulating sends the letters of dream once around into a new order

explanation.surface: A great old book once seemed a dream when it was published.
explanation.definitionFit: Boccaccio's fourteenth-century collection of tales is a literary classic.

clue.text: Hard to place

definitions.meaning: concrete or jelly that has firmed

explanation.definitionFit: Firmed solid is one sense; to put something somewhere is the other.

clue.text: Where the farmer will go to sow?

definitions.text: Where the farmer will go to sow?

parts.words: Where the farmer will go to sow?
parts.note: sow is the female pig, not planting seed, so the farmer visits the pig's pen

explanation.definitionFit: A pigpen is where a sow lives.

clue.text: Hint at gratuity

explanation.definitionFit: A useful pointer is one sense; extra cash for service is the other.

clue.text: A first principle in current heaters

definitions.meaning: a basic part of a subject
the coil in an electric fire or kettle that glows when current passes

explanation.definitionFit: A basic constituent is one sense; the resistance wire in electric fires is the other.

clue.text: Conclude there's no place for the damned

parts.note: to infer is to conclude from evidence

explanation.surface: Someone decides there is no hell.
explanation.definitionFit: Dante's hell is the abode of lost souls.

clue.text: Back wages? Just talk

indicators.note: back means the word for wages is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: pay is wages

explanation.surface: Union talk about arrears of pay comes to nothing but chatter.
explanation.definitionFit: To chatter or jabber noisily is idle talk.

clue.text: Possibly married someone who thought a lot of you

definitions.text: someone who thought a lot of you

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters of married could form another word

explanation.surface: Perhaps your spouse was once a fan.
explanation.definitionFit: A fan holds someone in high regard.

clue.text: Left a number at the gate

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Someone drops off a number at the entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: A grand doorway or entrance is a portal.

clue.text: His origins may be found in Armagh

definitions.text: His origins may be found in Armagh

indicators.note: the letters of the Ulster place name can be rearranged to make a man's name

explanation.surface: A man's family came from Armagh, a county in Northern Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish forename and surname, here shown sharing letters with an Irish county.

clue.text: Angry outbursts in play

definitions.meaning: a public display of temper, as in making a fuss
the divisions of the acts of a drama

explanation.definitionFit: Tantrums in public are one sense; segments of a drama are the other.

clue.text: In opera Eugene shows singular spirit

parts.note: singular means one in number
gin is an alcoholic spirit

explanation.surface: In an opera the hero Eugene displays a unique character.
explanation.definitionFit: Tchaikovsky's opera Eugene Onegin is named after its title character.

clue.text: They're a blend of the main races

definitions.note: the definition reads as the people are, with the verb as link

indicators.note: blending mixes the letters of main races together

explanation.surface: A claim about the US as a melting pot of peoples.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The' is a link here; only MAIN RACES are mixed.
explanation.definitionFit: The population of the United States is famously drawn from many peoples.

clue.text: Save cash

definitions.meaning: to save a soul is to deliver it
to cash a voucher or bond is to exchange it for money

explanation.definitionFit: Rescue from sin is one sense; converting a coupon into money is the other.

clue.text: Where to find children who have lost their parents

definitions.text: Where to find children who have lost their parents

parts.words: Where to find children who have lost their parents
parts.note: a home for children whose mothers and fathers have died, read straight with a teasing hint of lost property

explanation.definitionFit: An institution that houses children without families.

clue.text: Quake in the centre, more or less

indicators.note: in shows the letters sit inside the words centre and more

explanation.surface: An earthquake measured at its epicentre, roughly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'more or less' wants to be an anagram signal, but the answer is in plain sight across 'centre, more'; 'or less' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: A shaking of the ground, as in a small earthquake.

clue.text: Auspicious undertaking?

definitions.meaning: giving a pledge or vow to do something

explanation.definitionFit: Hopeful in prospect is one sense; making a pledge is the other.
